subject: TUI Knowledge graph W2: typed relation boundary and spatial navigation (PR #218)
result: PR #218 open, 13/13 CI green, mergeable. Fixed the presentation boundary that fetched a typed KnowledgeRelationView then discarded it via to_value() and scraped a non-existent "related" key — every provider-bearing neighbourhood rendered "no typed resource relations". Added pure deterministic graph_layout (four bands, focus-centred, BTree-only), graph presentation state with recenter/back/depth/filter, narrow grouped fallback, mouse-keyboard parity, provenance-bearing Inspector. Containment is read structurally off endpoint role, not relation name (member arrives in both directions after cc1e152). Two consumer-side regression tests for #216 empirically fail against the pre-cc1e152 provider. OPEN: (1) owner-contract gap — RelationEdge carries no containment signal, so every consumer must keep a private relation-name list; draft issue written but unfiled, awaiting owner decision. (2) #43 is closed COMPLETED with seven acceptance claims its renderer never satisfied (no recentre existed at all; performance.rs had zero relation content; degraded state rendered a false absence); #218 is what backs them; standing correction not yet made. (3) W1 Universal Navigator untouched by design. (4) No physical/provider acceptance claimed — #211 W10 proving matrix unrun.
